modalities_per_step: consume independent CFP/UWF loaders once each per epoch; mean over remaining modalities; no oversampling, pairing or alignment
epoch_seed_rule: optimization_seed + epoch * 1000; worker/shuffle seed adds 10 for UWF; nonpersistent workers
augmentation: unchanged vendor Stage25E Resize BICUBIC 384, horizontal flip .5, ColorJitter .10/.10/.08/.02, ImageNet normalization
resume_unit: completed epoch; interrupted epoch restarts from previous committed epoch
trial_order: For each seed, four controls in declared order; GPU0 seed2026; GPU1 seed2027 then seed2028. Reuse frozen reference metadata only.
